title: Vibrant Vegetable Ethiopian Coriander Tibs
description: A tangy and flavorful Ethiopian-inspired dish featuring coriander leaves, perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat a raclette-grill or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and swirl to coat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cabbage and cook until slightly wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the coriander leaves and berbere spice, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the leaves are slightly wilted and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional coriander leaves if desired.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, reheating as needed.
